trans.sense: (acronym) The end of the world as we know it
trans.word: o fim do mundo como nós o conhecemos

examples.text:
“Teotwawki.” He shrugged.
“Where'd that come from?” English, please?
 “Teotwawki,” Rabbit repeated.
 That's helpful. “Which means?”
 “‘The end of the world as we know it.’ Teotwawki. I'll probably shorten it eventually.”
